finding: v1.1.5 reads document.querySelector('p.kr-prompt'), which returns a hidden duplicate in the Krillocity wait card; the real visible prompt is the second p.kr-prompt. Result: panel stays 'Waiting for the next prompt…' and the bot never answers.

evidence.text: Name an animal native to North America

observed_states: PROMPT 4 OF 7 / 23s clock ticking, panel status 'Waiting for the next prompt…', botState 'waiting', zero /api/answers lookups queued
fix: promptEl() selects the first visible non-empty p.kr-prompt; isVisible()/visible()/promptText() use it.
